name: atlas
description: Test and operate macOS GUI apps in a desktop of its own (a hidden second login or a VM), without touching the person's desktop; guides setup when Atlas is missing.

interface.shortDescription: Test Mac apps in a hidden second desktop
interface.longDescription: Run, click through and screenshot macOS apps in a desktop of its own (a hidden second login or a VM) while the person keeps using their own desktop. Guides installation and setup when Atlas is not ready.
defaultPrompt: Open this app in Atlas and show me its first screen
Check that the Save dialog works in Atlas's desktop
Set up Atlas on this Mac
